text: {"test_cases": 30, "summary": "Added a 30-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering strcspn() empty/single-byte inputs, first/middle/last/absent reject positions, set semantics, NUL-terminator handling, high-bit bytes, exhaustive position and length sweeps, and cross-checks against strpbrk/strlen/strchr."}

{"test_cases": 15, "summary": "Wrote lib/agent_kunit.c with a 15-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" for string_get_size covering zero/zero-blocksize inputs, byte values, 999/1000 and 1023/1024 divisor edges, significant-digit selection, decimal rounding and carry in both bases, block-size interaction, every unit suffix through Yi/Y plus the UNK overflow, the 2^32 pre-reduction, modifier flags, return lengths and buffer truncation, with all expected strings hand-verified against the algorithm since the sandbox blocked running a reference model."}

{"test_cases": 26, "summary": "Wrote a 26-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c that exercises string_escape_mem across every escape class, NP/NA/NAP/APPEND/only-dictionary combinations, all 256 byte values, precedence, embedded NULs, and exhaustive output-size truncation with overrun canaries."}

{"test_cases": 18, "summary": "Wrote an 18-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering string_unescape across all flag classes, octal/hex digit-count and overflow limits, invalid and trailing escapes, embedded NUL output, exact size/truncation boundaries with poison-guarded buffers, in-place use, header wrappers, and return-value invariants."}

{"test_cases": 16, "summary": "Wrote a 16-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering get_option() return codes 0-3, parsed values, exact pointer advancement (comma consumed, hyphen not), NULL/empty strings, lone hyphens, radix prefixes, INT_MIN/INT_MAX, trailing junk, validator mode with NULL pint, and multi-call sequential parsing."}

{"test_cases": 41, "summary": "Added a 41-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering get_options() lists, hex/octal/negative values, range expansion, array-size boundaries (nints 0/1/exact/short), validation mode, end-pointer positions and error paths such as garbage, reversed and open ranges, with sentinel checks for out-of-bounds writes."}

{"test_cases": 22, "summary": "Wrote a 22-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering memparse decimal/hex/octal parsing, every K-E suffix in both cases with chain consistency checks, 64-bit wrap-around, retptr placement (NULL, consumed suffix, unknown trailing chars), empty/non-numeric/bare-suffix inputs, hex-prefix and hex-digit-E edge cases, and realistic size@addr and comma-list patterns."}

{"test_cases": 14, "summary": "Wrote a 14-case KUnit suite in lib/agent_kunit.c for __siphash_aligned covering official SipHash-2-4 reference vectors for lengths 0-63, every 1-7 byte tail case, block multiples, equivalence with the fixed-width and unaligned helpers, per-byte sensitivity inside and insensitivity outside the length, length and key mixing, zero-key validity, position independence, and large inputs."}

{"test_cases": 12, "summary": "Wrote a 12-case KUnit suite \"agent_test\" in lib/agent_kunit.c covering __hsiphash_aligned with reference vectors for lengths 0-63, zero length, agreement with hsiphash_Nu32 and __hsiphash_unaligned, per-byte and past-the-end sensitivity for every tail length, length encoding, byte order, key sensitivity, determinism, long inputs, prefix-only dependence and collision checks, falling back to __hsiphash_unaligned on configs where the aligned symbol is not built."}
